book.name: Luk
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Luk kaavu

content: Jon sen nalipis hil-ato nêêl tanasin

Busin sen Taibilias tu Lom-ate yêêv bop Sisa be nanggin sil-ambe la valup ta nomaayuuh-ambe laam namaavaalu, tombe nêêl-ambe Pontias Pilata tu yêêv bop-ambe nanggin hil Yuda, tonde Helot tu yêêv bop-ambe nanggin hil Galili, de hali Pilip tu yêêv bop-ambe nanggin hil Itulia osin hil Talakonaitis. Tonde Laisenias tu yêêv-ambe nanggin hil Abilini,
+ o 3:2 Luk 1:80*tonde Anas ayuuh Kaiapas latu yêêv bop vu kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato, ond hôôk busin-anju Sakaalia-te noow Jon nando taaku lumbalaamb tombe Anutu-te vakasin laam vu,
+ o 3:3 Sin 13:24; 19:4*om la hatup hôôk lohvu taaku pin sen neep ngaaho vu bel bop Yoladan-ato be nanêêl tanasin nambe hil langgilin londpayo be lanjipis bel in nambe Anutu kawiiy silate nipaya na.
+ o 3:4-6 Ais 40:3-5*Lohvu Yesaia nêêl vakasin lak Jon munggin-ambe neep hôôk kaapiyaa-to nambe,

content.text: “Omaaho ti nateey vu taaku lumbalaamb nambe,
‘Ham samu Omaaho Bop-ate mop, ham galo yite mop nanjip nivalok.’

Le baahu taaku metokin pin-ambe naatu doos jak, de le daav kandu bop osin pasiv pin gaving-ambe naatu taambut jak, tonde mopaatôôv pin sen nivanjusin-ato ond le nivalok jak. De mopaatôôv pin sen tatuuh nandôô-to ond le nanjip nivasa,
+ o 3:6 Luk 2:30-31; Tit 2:11*tombe hil pin davu lanji mend ak kul sen Anutu nawiing in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato.”

content: + o 3:7 Mat 12:34; 23:33*Tombe hil ngeeyaata lalaam lôôt in nambe Jon jipis sil, tombe Jon nêêl vu sil nambe, “Nyêêy anipaya noondin ham. Lati nêêl vu ham? Ham-ame alohvu nambe ham napak in Anutu-te ahekalin sen le naatok naam vu taamusin-ato le.

+ o 3:8 Jon 8:33,39*Om ham anggilin ham alompayo be ham ambiing va nivasa in yanjak ni naambe ham ahilin ham vasa ond mem. Hamambe hamate danggakook neep vu Abalaam om Anutu le ji ham nivasa? Malis. Sa naanêêl vu ham naambe Anutu lohvu nambe jêêvu tatuuh-anjo be daatu Abalaam-ate hil.
+ o 3:9 Mat 7:19; Jon 15:6*Kôôv navu neep nandeng haah dangga lung la, om haah pin sen me-nayiis nôôn anivasaa-to ond le buv-ambe gaate jakana kin.”
Jon nêêl nambêênju tombe hil ngeeyaataa-ju lalingin nambe, “Om hey e aambiing vaati?”
Tombe nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Omaaho ti-te lolop yuuh nando ond bu ango vu omaaho sen lolop maa-to, tonde omaaho ti-te vanôôn nando ond yik bu vaalu vu omaaho sen nativak in vanôôn-ato.”
+ o 3:12 Luk 7:29*Tonde hil sen dako taakis-ato heey lalup in nambe Jon jipis sil gaving, tombe lalingin Jon nambe, “Kaputung, hey e aambiing vaati?”
Le nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham oo gako mone nohvu gaaman danêêl-ato de ham-ame gako heey savok na le.”

Tonde yik hil ngaamong vaha-so heey lalingin nambe, “De hey ond hey e aambiing vaati?” Tombe nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham-ame anyiis hil osin ham-ame tatuhin vakasin ak sil in nambe lambu mone vu ham e. Yik mone sen ham nako lak hamate kul-ato ond ham gako mu be lung, de vakasin nama.”
Tombe hil pin nahand nalak-ambe kand navu vakasin ak Jon hôôk sil alondpayo lôôt nambe, “Mak peey e Jon-anju yi omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato.”

+ o 3:16 Sin 13:25*Om Jon nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Sa naalipis ham ak bel amu, nganjo omaaho ti navu taamuyin sa ond yite niwêêk savok sa. Sak sa omaaho nipaya, same sa ningg vasa in nambe sa kavaayin yite suul osin saambiing kul vaalu naambe hil kul-aso dawiing vu silate yêêv e. Omaahôô-ju ond le biing-ambe ham anim vasa jak Vavi Vaambuung-ate niwêêk osin kin sen ja hamate nipayaa-to.

Puvu yite haah navu salak hôôk nama lung la in nambe japêêh kaalekaale na, le mem naasupin vanôôn nôôn dukana bayêên vanôôn-ate, tonde vanôôn naavi osin ahesa ond le basi jakana kin ti yoo monatum danggata.”
Jon nêêl tanasin vaalu ngeeyaata having in nambe bêêl sil akand jak, osin monanêêl banye nivasa vu hil.
+ o 3:19 Mat 14:3-4; Mak 6:17-18*Tonde busin ti tombe Jon nêêl yêêv bop Helot in dangga nambe Helot hali Pilip ond Helot lakin vane Helodias, tonde va nipaya vaalu sen Helot wiing-ato neep having.
Tombe Helot-ate nipaya pin-anju neep, tonde taamusin atombe wiing nipaya ti lukala having nambe hatung Jon hôôk kalaambus malis amu.
Jon lipis Yesu
Hil pin mondalipis bel tombe yik Yesu lipis bel having. Lipis bel lung la tonde monalohak atombe baandoni kahe,

+ o 3:22 Mat 17:5; Luk 9:35; Jon 1:32; 2Pi 1:17*tonde Vavi Vaambuung ani nambe manak tumbaliiy-ambe hato lakando yi, tonde lava ti laam vu baandoni nambe, “Sa Noongg hong. Sahengg having hong osin sahengg anivasa vu hong.”
Yesu Kalisi-te danggakook-anjo
+ o 3:23 Luk 4:22; Jon 6:42*Busin sen Yesu hako kul ak-ato ond yite ta lohvu doo-ti be nomaayuuh, tombe hil lanêêl yi nambe Yusep noow. Tonde Yusep ond Hilai noow,
de Hilai ond Matat noow, de Matat ond Liwi noow, de Liwi ond Melkai noow, de Melkai ond Janai noow, de Janai ond Yusep noow.
Tonde Yusep-anju Matataias noow, de Matataias ond Amos noow, de Amos ond Neam noow, de Neam ond Eslai noow, de Eslai ond Nagai noow.
Tonde Nagaii-ju Maat noow, de Maat ond Matataias noow, de Matataias-anju ond Semen noow, de Semen ond Josek noow, de Josek ond Joda noow.
+ o 3:27 1Kro 3:17,19; Esra 3:2*Tonde Jodaa-ju ond Joanan noow, de Joanan ond Lesa noow, de Lesa ond Selababel noow, de Selababel ond Sialtiel noow, de Sialtiel-anju Nelai noow.
Tonde Nelai ond Melkai noow, de Melkai ond Edai noow, de Edai ond Kosam noow, de Kosam ond Elmadam noow, de Elmadam ond El noow.
Tonde El-anju Yosua noow, de Yosua ond Eliesa noow, de Eliesa ond Jolim noow, de Jolim ond Matat noow, de Matat ond Liwi noow.
Tonde Liwii-ju Simeon noow, de Simeon ond Yuda noow, de Yuda ond Yusep noow, de Yusep-anju ond Jonam noow, de Jonam ond Elaiakim noow.
+ o 3:31 2Sml 5:14*Tonde Elaiakim-anju Melia noow, de Melia ond Mena noow, de Mena ond Matata noow, de Matata ond Naatan noow, de Naatan ond Devit noow.
+ o 3:32 1Sml 16:1,13; Rut 4:17-22*Tonde Devit-anju Jesi noow, de Jesi ond Obet noow, de Obet ond Boas noow, de Boas ond Salmon noow, de Salmon ond Naason noow.
+ o 3:33 Jen 29:35*Tonde Naason-anju Aminadap noow, de Aminadap ond Atmin noow, de Atmin ond Anai noow, de Anai ond Heslon noow, de Heslon ond Peles noow, de Peles ond Yuda noow.
+ o 3:34 Jen 21:3; 25:26*Tonde Yudaa-ju Yaakop noow, de Yaakop ond Isak noow, de Isak ond Abalaam noow, de Abalaam ond Tela noow, de Tela ond Neho noow.
Tonde Nehôô-ju Seluk noow, de Seluk ond Leyu noow, de Leyu ond Pelek noow, de Pelek ond Ebe noow, de Ebe ond Sela noow.
+ o 3:36 Jen 11:10-26*Tonde Selaa-ju Kainan noow, de Kainan ond Apaksat noow, de Apaksat ond Sem noow, de Sem ond Noa noow, de Noa ond Lamek noow.
Tonde Lamek-anju Metusala noow, de Metusala ond Enok noow, de Enok ond Jalet noow, de Jalet ond Mahalalel noow, de Mahalalel ond Kainan noow.
+ o 3:38 Jen 4:25–5:32*Tonde Kainan-anju Inos noow, de Inos ond Set noow, de Set ond Adam noow, tonde Adam ond Anutu noow.
